svg.text: Search first: 'Filter issues'.
Project ▾ first, only with 2+ projects (#3283).
A set filter: its value in the accent.
Board ▾ last of the filters; issues only,
Mac + web (#3282). ✕ Clear when a filter is set.
Sort ▾ at the trailing edge, apart.
Selected: the accent fill. ↑ ↓ move it,
Return opens; Back selects the row it left.
Hover: the list's hover colour.
A board's column ('In Progress') in grey
after the number on line 2.
Two repos in the list: the repo shows on
line 2's trailing edge.
Paging: the next page loads when the last
row shows; no More link.
Refresh in the toolbar, ⌘R; it spins.
Menus, open
Sort ▾: a tick on the one in use.
Not the default: 'Sort: Cost ▾'
in the accent.
Board ▾: grouped by
project; a board
from a URL that no
project has stays
on the list.

svg.text: A PR: checks glyph and review word before
the comment count (parts.md §2).
Draft: the grey PR glyph, and 'Draft' in
grey after the number. Checks running: a dot.
Merged and closed rows are not dimmed;
the glyph and line 2 ('merged 2 w ago') say it.
State ▾ for PRs: Open, Merged, Closed, All.
No Board ▾ on Pull requests (as today).
One repo in the list: no repo on line 2.

svg.text: State ▾ Closed: done (purple tick) and not
planned (grey slash) together; line 2 says
'closed … ago' and 'not planned'.
Here the window is not key: the selected row
has the light accent fill, as a List does.
